provenance.notes: public datasets and MEASURED laptop runs (per-dataset data_kind inside). run_label=colab-a100. Hardware: {'device': 'cuda', 'python': '3.13.16', 'platform': 'Linux-6.6.159+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39', 'torch': '2.11.0+cu130', 'gpu': 'NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB'}

design.split: grid and carbon series: origins from 2026-05-01 (fixed test split); laptop: run2 = test, run1 = calibration run (zero-shot model: nothing is fitted on either)

leakage_rules.DA: CAISO day-ahead LMP for local day D is revealed from 13:00 Pacific on D-1 (assumed publication time); NaN before
leakage_rules.WX: Open-Meteo previous_day1 forecast: the value for valid time v is revealed from v minus 24 h; NaN beyond
leakage_rules.DEM: CAISO Outlook day-ahead demand forecast; same publication rule as DA (assumed)
leakage_rules.F: GB archived intensity forecast; vintage undocumented; revealed from v minus 24 h (assumed)
leakage_rules.S: schedule segments plus the observed start of the segment running at the origin
leakage_rules.K: next checkpoint = end of the last observed checkpoint + the segment's period; nominal write duration from run1
leakage_rules.L_realised: logged checkpoint intervals of the whole run (realised; NOT known at the origin; comparison only)

design.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap over origins (block = ceil(horizon / origin stride)), paired across configs, 1000 replicates, 95% percentile intervals
design.const_guard_rule: covariate rows (window, channel) that are exactly constant and not 0/1 are replaced by zeros before the model; counts in constant_rows_zeroed

gb_forecast_vintage.note: The API does not document the issue time of the archived forecast. An error far below 24 h persistence is consistent with a forecast issued closer to the valid time than one day; the ablation is conditional on the assumption that the value for time v was available at v minus 24 h.
